meta.title: AI Gijinka · Shared World, Individual Personas
meta.description:
Characters follow your selected DSH model, and you can choose your own character.

WORLD: Shared names, impressions, jokes and relationships.
CHARACTERS: Individual personalities, preferences and memories. Versions in one family share a character.

Add lore, edit personas, create characters or assign a model by talking to the AI in DSH chat.

OPTIONAL PET: Enable one model-linked companion in the settings below to display work status, statistics and available balance or plan information. Personas can also be used on their own.

Presets are only a starting point. Your choices come first.
